data.completion_memo: Implemented resource-scoped optimistic concurrency across Adashi. Project revision is notification-only; mutable resources expose monotonic versions; design mutations use explicit read/write guards; conflicts are structured and compact; mutation retries are idempotent; advisory intents have TTLs; memory supports append-only notes and canonical compaction; mockups have independent accepted and working versions; MCP, Tauri, and React callers were migrated. Verification: full Rust suite passed (54 tests, 0 failures), Vite production build passed, fresh adashi-mcp stdio verification found 33 tools with closed schemas, and git diff --check passed. No task-linked QA jobs existed.

lines:
Implement the approved formal design that decouples safe mutation preconditions from the global project revision.

Required behavior:
- Keep project_state.revision as a notification-only project change cursor. Bump it once after each successful changed transaction; never use it as the general overwrite-prevention gate.
- Add monotonically increasing resource versions to independently mutable design elements, relationships, UML artifacts, bindings, tasks, QA job definitions, lifecycle rules, canonical memory/protocol state, and mockup working and accepted state. Reads through MCP and Tauri must expose the relevant versions.
- Replace project-wide expectedRevision checks with resource-scoped expected versions for updates and deletes. Multi-resource design saves must carry an explicit read/write set, validate every required version and current dependency inside one transaction, and either store all changes or none.
- Allow independent creates under stable unique ids and commit-time referential validation. Concurrent creates of different resources must not conflict. Duplicate identity, stale targeted updates, and structural deletes with changed dependents must fail deterministically.
- Return compact structured conflicts containing resource kind, resource id, expected version, and current version. Agents and the dashboard reload only conflicted resources; there must be no blind retry or silent overwrite.
- Preserve semantic no-op behavior: no changed resource version and no project cursor bump.
- Add idempotency keys for mutation retries.
- Add advisory agent resource intents with agent/run identity and TTL. Intents help scheduling but never grant write authority, block a valid versioned commit, or substitute for concurrency checks.
- Add append-only, idempotent project memory notes keyed by run and optional task. Normal agent completion appends a note rather than replacing the shared memory body. Canonical memory compaction is an explicit coordinator operation conditioned on the canonical-memory version and must preserve notes that arrived after the compaction snapshot. Version the memory protocol rule separately.
- Give mockups independent accepted and working revisions so unrelated mockups never block each other and same-mockup overlap is detected precisely.
- Update every in-repo MCP and Tauri mutation caller in the same task. Do not introduce a Last-Write-Wins compatibility path. If a temporary legacy expectedRevision input is retained during migration, it must remain the stricter project-wide fallback and be clearly deprecated.
- Keep the dashboard's existing mounted-state and surgical merge behavior. Present resource-specific conflicts without resetting unrelated UI state.

Verification and regressions:
- Two agents updating different resources from the same initial project cursor both succeed.
- Two agents updating the same resource produce one success and one precise non-storing conflict.
- Disjoint items inside task, QA, rule, design, and mockup families do not conflict.
- Mixed design changes remain atomic when any targeted version or dependency is stale.
- Concurrent unique creates succeed; duplicate ids and unsafe structural deletion fail without partial state.
- Memory note retry is idempotent, parallel notes are preserved, and compaction cannot drop a later note.
- Expired intents disappear and live intents remain advisory only.
- No-op retries do not increment resource versions or the project cursor.
- UI polling still detects external commits and merges changed records without resetting active workspaces.
- Generated MCP schemas remain closed and operation-specific, and fresh stdio verification proves the new contracts.

Do not add CRDTs, long-held database locks, an event bus, or a full collaborative editor. Keep SQLite transactions short and make correctness depend on resource versions plus commit-time validation.

data.title: Implement resource-scoped optimistic concurrency for parallel agents
